id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

action.description: The action button element to the right of grouped input element.

postfixGroupField.description:
The postfix input element, appending to the right of groupField element.
If postfixGroupField is not present, groupField will be 100% width and widthRatioPercentage will not be used.

widthRatioPercentage.description:
A string that represents one of the many preset of width ratio percentages of left and right field in the order that the fields are rendered.
The option is ignored if postfixGroupField is empty.
The viable options as specified in {@link UiSdlGroupedInputWidthRatios} are
1. "20:80" (default value if postfixGroupField is present and withRatioPercentage is not present)
2. "80:20"
3. "50:50"
4. "60:40"
5. "40:60"

title:
Note: The value of the grouped input component is stored
in a structured object where each key represents the
fieldName of each grouped inputs represented by attribute `groupField` and `postfixGroupField`.
If `key` is the fieldName for `groupField` and `key2` is the fieldName for `postfixGroupField` then the value of grouped input would be
e.g. { key: value, key2: value2 }.
name: UiSdlGroupedInput
